name: drawkit
description: View, inspect and lint DWG/DXF drawings. Reference build for the Omakase CAD workstream.

scripts.build:sidecar: DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1 dotnet build sidecar -c Release -o bin/sidecar
scripts.build: npm run build:sidecar && npm run build:viewer
scripts.fixtures: uv run --quiet --with ezdxf --python 3.13 python -I fixtures/make_fixtures.py fixtures
